description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 1750/13 of 20.03.2013 D/S Division, Homagama
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying land parcel details, extents, servitude rights, and access rights for multiple properties in the Colombo District. The content focuses entirely on land registration matters, including cadastral map references, parcel numbers, and property rights modifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
